articles.title: 16-year-old girl gang-raped inside moving bus during 47-km ride to Delhi
articles.description: A 16-year-old student was allegedly gang-raped inside a moving sleeper bus. She had boarded the vehicle seeking help while stranded in heavy rain. The driver and conductor then allegedly raped her and threatened her life. They abandoned the terrified teenager near Kashmere Gate bus terminal. Police arrested the accused and seized the bus for examination.

Meet the students who built DiveGuard, a low-cost underwater messaging system
articles.description: A group of Chinese students has created DiveGuard, an affordable system designed for underwater communication. By utilizing acoustic signals, this innovative technology allows divers to send concise text messages, thereby enhancing safety and teamwork in aquatic environments. DiveGuard was recognized as a finalist in the prestigious 2026 Conrad Challenge and offers a reliable communication alternative where traditional networks are unavailable.

Centuries-old plaque on eight people’s teeth preserved a surprisingly detailed menu of what they ate in Osaka
articles.description: Dental plaque analysis revealed diverse diets for Edo-period Osaka commoners. Researchers found proteins from 17 food types, including luxury red sea bream. This suggests developing markets made once-exclusive foods accessible to ordinary people. Salmon proteins indicated food traveled long distances via extensive shipping networks. Even cottonseed oil and terrestrial animal meat were consumed by these individuals.

articles.title: Rupee falls 13 paise to 95.56 as crude rises, Fed hike bets strengthen dollar
articles.description: On Monday, the Indian rupee began its trading session lower versus the US dollar. The decline was influenced by rising crude oil prices and increasing geopolitical tensions. Furthermore, the prospect of a Federal Reserve rate hike has strengthened the dollar. In response, the Reserve Bank of India is taking measures to stabilize the rupee, while domestic stocks face downward pressure from foreign investors offloading shares.

articles.title: Oil prices jump over 2% after US-Iran direct conflict re-ignites after a month of pause
articles.description: Following a U.S. military strike on Iranian launchers in the strategic Strait of Hormuz, oil prices have surged. In retaliation, Iran launched attacks on two U.S. air bases in Jordan. Jordan's military successfully intercepted eight missiles aimed at its territory early Monday, escalating the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, now entering its sixth month. Shipping activities through the Strait of Hormuz have notably dipped due to rising tensions.

articles.title: Naya Rivera’s son to make film debut in 'The Burning Valley'
articles.description: Josey Dorsey, son of the late Naya Rivera, has secured his first acting role. He will appear in the upcoming film 'The Burning Valley' with his father. This project follows Josey's previous theatre experience in West Virginia. The film explores a steelworker's journey after losing his job. It is a poetic film about deindustrialization and emotional truth.

articles.title: Suniel Shetty: 'Gore is what I don't like about films today'
articles.description: At 65, Suniel Shetty has undergone a significant shift in his career's focus, choosing inner contentment over monetary ambitions. Embracing his age, he champions the importance of age-appropriate roles to maintain his relevance in the ever-changing Bollywood landscape. Shetty observes a transformation in how masculinity is depicted today compared to his early days, and his strategic choices and optimistic mindset help sustain his lasting influence in the film industry.

articles.title: Priyadarshan reveals Saif Ali Khan almost starred in 'Garam Masala'
articles.description: Filmmaker Priyadarshan revealed Saif Ali Khan almost starred in 'Garam Masala' but the script was delayed. Priyadarshan's initial meeting with Saif focused on his father, cricketer Mansur Ali Khan Pataudi. He admired Tiger Pataudi since his youth and recalled an injury trying to meet him. Discussions about Tiger Pataudi became a recurring topic during the making of 'Haiwaan'. 'Haiwaan' reunites Saif Ali Khan and Akshay Kumar after eighteen years.

articles.title: Manasi Parekh reaches Mumbai after Nepal - Tibet floods
articles.description: Actor Manasi Parekh returned to Mumbai after a challenging journey through flood-affected areas. Her return trip from Tibet was disrupted by landslides and poor road conditions. She faced delays and had to walk across a damaged road near the Nepal border. The journey to Kathmandu was described as extremely rough but ultimately rewarding. Parekh had visited one disaster site just five days before the flash floods occurred.
